column1: # The licence of every source the build may read, declared once (PRB-1545). forge build holds every source a product reads
#   against it: before the producers run, every input build/products declares and every catalogued text's sources; after them,
#   every input the manifest records, every kept product under external/, every text's declaration and every served picture.
# source: a file or folder under Resources/; an input is held to the row whose source is its longest leading run of segments.
#   Essenthos/external/<set> is a dataset's rows exported once into the store.
# layer: what part of the source the row speaks for. A source read by a product must pass on every layer that is not never.
# served: content (its words, numbers or rows are served), derived (only what the project derives from it, such as links, is
#   served; its own content is not), never (no product may read it: kept for measurement, by hand or as a candidate, or a
#   part the reader refuses, beside another layer of the same source).
# licence: as the source states it. redistribution: public-domain, permitted, permitted-with-attribution, share-alike,
#   non-commercial-only, prohibited, unknown (nobody grants anything, or it cannot be read), or own (this project's work,
#   under the licence the owner sets for all of it).
# credit: where the reader is told whose it is (RUL-0181): dataset:<id> of Datasets.All, text:<SLUG> (text:* for a part source
#   every text that reads it credits), picture (each picture's own credit line), map (the map's credit line). - for never.
# declared: where its licence was read, under Resources/, or - where nothing holds it. exception: the tickets under which the
#   owner keeps a source whose redistribution is prohibited or unknown; the build reports it as an exception and does not fail.
